Zodiac FAQ

How is my zodiac sign worked out?

Your sign depends on your date of birth. The year is divided into twelve parts, each with a sign. Check your date in the table above, or enter it in the tool.

How is the fortune produced?

The tool picks from ready-written playful lines using a simple rule based on the length of your name and your date. There is no astronomical calculation, so do not take it as true.

Are horoscopes and fortunes real?

No. They are for entertainment only and there is no basis for believing them.

Are my name and date of birth saved?

No. Both are used inside your browser only.
